rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: At the AICC briefing of 28 August 2022, Central Election Authority chairman Madhusudan Mistry reads the 'Schedule of Election for Congress President' (notification 22 September; nominations 24-30 September; scrutiny 1 October; withdrawal and final list 8 October; a poll, if there is more than one candidate, on 17 October; counting and declaration on 19 October 2022), and Shri K.C. Venugopal says that the Working Committee, meeting under the chairpersonship of 'Hon'ble Congress President Smt. Sonia Gandhi', 'Unanimously ... approved the final schedule given by the CEA Chairman'.

locator.item: schedule items 1-10 and Shri K.C. Venugopal's statement
